fusions.name: Faultline Heave
fusions.desc: Sends strands through the ground to the first enemy in their path, where they erupt as jagged stone for 30 earth damage. Every enemy within 3 tiles of it takes 80% of that.

fusions.name: Wedge and Widen
fusions.desc: Root hairs work into the target and split it for 8 earth damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Holds 4 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Dug In
fusions.desc: Your hair drives into the ground as roots, reducing the damage you take by 20% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Taproot
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, root hairs draw from the ground beneath you, restoring 3 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
